title: Fix CI regression in MockAgentResult new_messages fallback

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: CI failed at tests/testing/test_mock_agent_additional.py::test_mock_agent_result_repr_and_new_messages_fallback after narrowing exceptions in MockAgentResult.new_messages. Fixing by preserving graceful fallback on converter failures while keeping explicit handling and diagnostics.
